description: Calculates return on ad spend from ad revenue and ad spend, and the break-even ROAS implied by gross margin, then says whether the campaign covers its product cost.

ad_revenue.description: Revenue attributed to the ads, in currency units.

ad_spend.description: Ad spend for the same period, in currency units.

currency.description: ISO currency code for display, for example INR, USD or AED. Defaults to INR.

name: roas_check
title: ROAS and break-even ROAS
